sqlMap.select: SELECT NVL(PO_NO ,' ') AS PO_NO, NVL(PO_SEQ,' ') AS PO_SEQ FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = NVL(TRIM(#BUYER#),' ') AND PO_NO = NVL(TRIM(#LEGACY_PO_NO#),' ') AND PO_SEQ = NVL(TRIM(TO_CHAR(#LEGACY_PO_SEQ#,'FM000000')),' ') AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = NVL(TRIM(#BUYER_ITEM_NO#),' ')

SELECT
TO_CHAR(COUNT(*)) AS TOT_CNT, TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(INV_QTY),0)) AS TOT_AMT, TO_CHAR(COUNT(DECODE(IF_FLAG,'E','X',NULL))) AS ERR_CNT, TO_CHAR(COUNT(DECODE(STATUS, 'D','D',NULL))) AS DEL_CNT FROM IF_IVDT WHERE BUYER = NVL(#BUYER#,' ') AND LEGACY_IV_NO = NVL(#LEGACY_IV_NO#,' ') AND REVISION = NVL(#REVISION#,' ')
